d:
Pakistan ke jalvayu parivartan mantri musadik malik shanghaee sahyog sangthan (essio) ke pahle 'daylog of sivilaijeshans' men hissa lene ke lie bharat aae hue hain. pakistan sarkar ke kisi mantri ka yah tin sal bad bharat daura hai. unki yatra ko lekar bharat ki vipakshi parti kangres ke virodh, malik ki ghumne ki yojnaon aur essio men die gae unke bhashan ki pakistan men kafi charcha hai.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
